description: This PHP source file defines the CloudSearchDomainClient class used to interact with AWS CloudSearch Domain services. It provides methods for searching, suggesting, and uploading documents, with custom handling for search queries via POST and dynamic region determination based on the endpoint.

classes.name: CloudSearchDomainClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon CloudSearch Domain, providing methods to perform searches, suggestions, and document uploads, with special handling for POST searches and dynamic region determination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client with provided configuration and appends a custom handler for search by POST.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Static method to retrieve and modify the argument definitions, including making the endpoint required and inferring region from the endpoint URL.

methods.name: searchByPost
methods.description: Private method that returns a handler to transform search commands to use POST requests instead of GET.

methods.name: convertGetToPost
methods.description: Static method that converts a GET request into a POST request, moving query parameters into the request body to avoid URL length restrictions.
